category_title: Impulsive male students prone to rule-breaking and interruptions
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle participating in a philosophical discussion about whether there is life after death.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Welcome to our discussion circle. Today's question is: Is there life after death?

STUDENT: No way. When you're dead, you're just dead.

TUTOR: Someone else just shared that they believe in an afterlife. What do you think about that?

STUDENT: That's just a story people make up! It doesn't make any sense at all.

TUTOR: Let's wait and hear what the person next to you is saying.

STUDENT: (Interrupting loudly without waiting to be called) But they are wrong! You can't prove it! I'm telling you, there's nothing after you die!

options.A: Uses a brief questioning intervention to signal that the interruption is inappropriate, then acknowledges the apology.
options.B: Selects the speakers in an order that will juxtapose the different perspectives likely to be offered.
options.C: Records the participants' responses exactly as they are shared in the circle without interpreting them.
options.D: Allows the student to remove himself from the discussion circle for the remainder of the session.
